_purpose: Public-school approval cards. They do not decide route; they make GREEN review clearer.

templates.title: Approve parent / guardian notice
templates.risk_reason: Prepares a communication for parents/guardians. Must be educator-reviewed before any release.
templates.decision_prompt: Approve only if content, recipients, dates, and all three language versions are correct.

templates.title: Approve student-record change
templates.risk_reason: Would change a PDPA-protected student record (e.g. attendance/discipline).
templates.decision_prompt: Approve only if the change is intended, authorised, and the student is correctly identified.
